note: Standard API prices per million tokens. Verify against the source before relying on them; add a new entry with a later effective_from date when a price changes.

models.note: For prompts of 100,000 tokens or fewer ($0.50 input and $2.50 output above that; AI_PROVIDER=anthropic caps a call at 60,000). Cache reads are 0.1x the input price.

tools_note: Per-call fees for provider tools, on top of the model's tokens (the web search tool's search content is billed as input tokens at the model row above). Read by the services web search (services/world/search.py); add a new entry with a later effective_from date when a price changes.
